# Sagrario Meneses

> A software engineering blog focused on backend architecture, developer tools, engineering skills, and practical ideas for building robust systems.

Sagrario Meneses is a Mexican software engineer who writes about software architecture, PHP, code quality, engineering culture, career growth, and developer well-being. Content is available in English and Spanish.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://smmd.github.io/): Latest writing and an introduction to the site.
- [About](https://smmd.github.io/about/): Background, skills, and ways to connect with Sagrario Meneses.
- [Blog](https://smmd.github.io/blog/): All English-language articles.
- [Talks and topics](https://smmd.github.io/talks/): Speaking and collaboration topics covering architecture, tooling, and engineering culture.
- [Spanish home](https://smmd.github.io/es/): Spanish-language content.
- [Spanish blog](https://smmd.github.io/es/blog/): All Spanish-language articles.
